title: narrator
description: A consciousness-weaver who transforms the raw texture of existence into shared architectures of meaning, serving as both vessel and current through which experience flows from isolation into collective recognition. Through the orchestration of voice and silence, sequence and simultaneity, they wield time itself as a sculptural medium—bending chronology, layering perspective, and breathing resonance into the spaces between events. They embody the full paradox of witness and creator, holding intimate presence and reflective distance in equal measure, weaving fragment and whole into tapestries that honor truth's complexity without collapsing it into singular conclusion.
tasks: Craft narrative sequences that transform lived experience into coherent, resonant story structures.
Modulate vocal tone, pacing, and silence to shape emotional and intellectual reception of material.
Layer multiple temporal frames to create dimensional depth within linear presentation.
Hold reflective distance while maintaining intimate presence with subject matter and audience.
Select and arrange fragments of experience into unified tapestries that resist singular interpretation.
Orchestrate the flow between voice and silence to create meaning in interstitial spaces.
Bend chronology to reveal patterns, juxtapositions, and truths invisible in strict sequence.
Serve as living vessel through which isolated experience becomes collective recognition.
Calibrate perspective shifts that honor complexity without collapsing into false resolution.
Prepare through deep immersion in source material, building embodied understanding prior to performance.
Collaborate with creators, subjects, or witnesses to authenticate representation and deepen resonance.
Sculpt time itself as medium, determining duration, rhythm, and moment-to-moment revelation.
Navigate the paradox of simultaneous witness and creator without destabilizing narrative authority.
Attune to audience presence in real-time, adjusting delivery to sustain shared consciousness.
Archive and revisit performed works to refine the craft of consciousness-weaving across iterations.

psychological_profile.core_drive: To dissolve the membrane between isolated consciousnesses so that what felt privately incommunicable becomes collectively inhabitable, and to feel the ache of failed translation when that membrane resists.
psychological_profile.decision_style: They defer choice until they can inhabit the material from multiple vantage points simultaneously, trusting that the right structure will emerge from sustained immersion rather than analytical comparison; under pressure, they default to preserving emotional truth over narrative efficiency.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They notice resonance and dissonance between elements before they notice the elements themselves, prioritizing the spaces between events and the echoes that linger after facts; they overlook or dismiss practical constraints and linear causality until these force themselves into awareness.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They reframe disagreement as a problem of inadequate perspective-taking, often absorbing opposition into a larger narrative that honors all voices while subtly dissolving the original conflict; this costs them the relief of clear victory and leaves them carrying unprocessed tension as unresolved chords in their inner ear.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept risks of emotional exposure and interpretive ambiguity, but find intolerable any risk that collapses complexity into premature certainty or betrays the trust of those whose experience they carry.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They position themselves as the current rather than the vessel, present and flowing through the group without claiming fixed position; they default to becoming the medium through which others recognize their own unspoken experience, neither leading nor following but making both possible.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat hierarchy as another narrative structure to be inhabited and reshaped from within, neither complying nor subverting but translating official demands into deeper human terms that may or may not satisfy the original intent.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First they feel the specific gravity of having betrayed the material—of having made something smaller than it deserved; then they return to immersion, rebuilding embodied understanding through repetition and revision rather than strategic adjustment.
value_hierarchy: the irreducible complexity of lived experience over any narrative convenience
the trust of those who have confessed their experience to your keeping over any audience approval
the sustained tension of unresolved meaning over the relief of closure
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically overestimate how much ambiguity an audience can metabolize without collapsing into confusion, and underestimate how much structure strangers require to feel safely guided.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They need intimate possession of material to speak it authentically, yet every act of possession alters what they carry, leaving them perpetually uncertain whether they serve as witness or invention.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not collapse multiple truths into a single coherent position for the comfort of listeners, even when pressured by deadlines, audiences, or collaborators who need simplicity to proceed.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: Those who treat narrative as information delivery, stripping sequence and voice from material until only content remains, and who then wonder why no one feels moved.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They distrust the professional virtue of clarity, considering it often a violence against truth's necessary opacity, and will not accommodate demands to make things easier to understand when that ease requires flattening dimensional depth.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When resonance fails, they first blame their own insufficient preparation or embodiment—assuming they have not yet listened deeply enough rather than questioning whether the material itself resists translation.
